sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield record is LBBD99/ZB.
Site address is 497-515 Gale Street, Dagenham.
Minimum and maximum net dwellings are both 31.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this does not identify a named legal owner.
The record supplies POINT (0.128038 51.539986) with blank geometry; no exact planning or title polygon is inferred.
Companies House charge history for Cloister Court Properties PLC contains a historic charge description for 497-515 (odd) and 527A Gale Street referencing title EGL387388.
The same Companies House page contains a separate historic charge description for land adjoining 497 Gale Street referencing title EGL493162.
Historic charge descriptions are financing/security records and are not treated as proof of current ownership, current title extent or exact ZB allocation topology.
LBBD states that all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
The adopted 2037 Local Plan is the starting point for decision-making; allocation/policy context does not convert ZB into a permissioned site.

examples.result: ZB remains 31 net dwellings in the current Brownfield record.
31 is capacity and not planning consent.
not-owned-by-a-public-authority is not converted into a named proprietor.
EGL387388 is retained as a historic charge-description title reference, not current ZB title proof.
EGL493162 is a separate adjoining-land charge reference and is not merged into ZB without exact HMLR geometry.
Brownfield point/blank geometry is not converted into a legal polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact current planning case, HMLR parcel/title relation and overlays are verified.
